mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_el.encounter_id, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'BED' THEN location.name END) AS bed_no, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN location.name END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(parent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN parent.name END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(grandparent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN grandparent.name END) ) AS ward_name, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(ranked_el.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN location.id END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(parent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN parent.id END), MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(grandparent.form_enum) = 'WARD' THEN grandparent.id END) ) AS ward_id FROM ( SELECT el.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY el.encounter_id, UPPER(el.form_enum) ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(el.status_enum) = 'ACTIVE' AND el.end_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, el.start_time DESC, el.created_at DESC, el.id DESC ) AS position_rank FROM adm_encounter_location el WHERE el.is_deleted = 0 AND UPPER(el.form_enum) IN ('WARD', 'BED') ) ranked_el INNER JOIN adm_location location ON location.id = ranked_el.location_id AND location.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location parent ON parent.id = location.parent_id AND parent.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location grandparent ON grandparent.id = parent.parent_id AND grandparent.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ranked_el.position_rank = 1 GROUP BY ranked_el.encounter_id ) stay ON stay.encounter_id = e.id
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS id, d.summary_no AS summaryNo, d.patient_id AS patientId, p.name AS patientName, stay.bed_no AS bedNo, d.medication_id AS medicationId, md.name AS drugName, md.total_volume AS spec, d.unit_code AS unit, d.quantity AS quantity, d.dispense_quantity AS dispenseQuantity, d.dosage_instruction AS dosageInstruction, d.frequency_code AS frequencyCode, d.lot_number AS lotNumber FROM med_medication_dispense d LEFT JOIN adm_patient p ON p.id = d.patient_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition md ON md.id = d.medication_id AND md.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_encounter e ON e.id = d.encounter_id AND e.is_deleted = 0
WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.summary_no = #{summaryNo} ORDER BY p.name, md.name
